userStories.title: Parse moments from judge response
acceptanceCriteria: Each moment object emitted by the judge is parsed into a Moment dataclass with the fields listed in Section 4.1
moment_id is computed as sha256(session.stable_id + dim_key + str(turn_index))[:16]
Severity is one of minor, moderate, major

userStories.title: Substring check against full transcript
acceptanceCriteria: Before persistence, quoted_excerpt is verified as a whitespace-normalized substring of the full raw transcript
Moments that fail the check are discarded (not fuzzy-matched)
A `[scorer] moment failed substring check` log line is emitted for each discard
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Redaction runs before persistence and before render
acceptanceCriteria: quoted_excerpt, why_it_lost_score, and suggested_alternative are run through the secret redactor before being written to the moments table
The redacted column is set to 1 when any field was modified by redaction
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: At most one moment per dim per session
acceptanceCriteria: If the judge returns more than one moment for the same (session, dim_key), only the first valid one is persisted
Subsequent ones are logged and discarded
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Persist to moments table
acceptanceCriteria: Every accepted Moment is written as a row in moments with all fields populated per the schema
Re-running on a session whose moments already exist is idempotent on moment_id
